text:
Hi all,

The nightly job failed because the server's disk was 98% full and the job had nowhere to write its output. Log rotation had been disabled in January, so logs built up every day until the disk filled. It was an easy thing to miss.

We cleared out the old logs, which freed 40 GB, and reran the job. It completed successfully at 02:40.

Log rotation is turned back on, so this shouldn't happen again. We're also looking at adding a disk usage alert so we hear about it earlier if space starts running low.

Thanks for raising it. If you want details on the cleanup or the alert setup, let me know.
